description: This PHP class defines a specialized display field for reporting with aggregate functions, extending a generic date display field. It maps specific field aliases to database fields and applies aggregation (e.g., MAX) when generating select statements for reports within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregate
classes.description: A display field class that includes aggregation logic for date fields in report generation within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Configures the display field by mapping its alias to entity and field names, and setting the aggregation function.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object used for this display field.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Retrieves the aggregation function set for this field (e.g., MAX).

methods.name: setAggregate
methods.description: Sets the aggregation function to be used for this field (e.g., MAX).

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Generates the SQL SELECT clause part for fetching aggregated date data using a 'NEW' DTO pattern.
